always: One solid object (or tight cluster) fills most of the card, drawn as a single readable silhouette with no cut-off except the bar scene.
Hard-surface objects (ticket, phone booth, planter, book, pump) keep straight edges and parallel sides; ticket edges, booth walls, book spine and planter rails run dead straight.
Corners are small, tight rounds or bevels, not blobs: ticket corners, book cover corners, planter posts, booth base slab.
Thin parts are kept thin and present: carousel chains, pump hose, planter legs and shelf board, book bookmark ribbons, cocktail glass stems, straw.
Soft goods (neck pillow, boxing gloves, sneakers, fins) are plump, rounded, overlapping masses, with smooth outlines and few straight runs.
Expected parts are all there: swing seats and chains, hose and nozzle on pump, door panes in booth, trunk and fronds on palm.
Silhouette is clean and closed with no fuzz; leaf and fruit edges are the only jagged contours (palm fronds, pineapple crown).
varies: Straightness: high on ticket, booth, planter, book; low on pillow, gloves, fins, palm.
Corner tightness: near-square on book/planter/booth; generous rounded on ticket (still moderate) and pump dome cap.
Thin share: very high on carousel, planter, bar stools and glasses; near zero on ticket, pillow, gloves, booth.
Solidity: solid blob on ticket, booth, book, gloves; holes and gaps on pillow, carousel, planter, bar stools.
Proportions: the pump has an oversized domed top and fat body, slightly toy-like; the other hard objects are near true proportion. Gloves and pillow are inflated, as the real objects are.
Tilt: ticket and book are rotated diagonally; booth, pump, carousel and planter stand upright.
never: Hard boxes swollen into pillows: booth, book, planter and ticket faces are never puffy.
Thin chains, hose, legs or ribbons thickened into sausages or dropped.
Rounded blob corners on rigid panels, boards or plates.
Missing signature parts (door, hose, chains, seats, trunk).
Ragged, melted or fuzzy outlines (aside from foliage and the soft shadow bleed on the bar card).
generator_wording: Draw the object at true proportions, simplified. Rigid things (boxes, books, booths, boards, panels) have flat faces, straight parallel edges and tight small corner bevels. Keep chains, hoses, ribbons, legs and rails thin and present. Only inherently soft items (pillows, gloves, shoes) are plump. Include every expected part; the outline stays clean and closed.
